one-illness-away.name: Medical bills
one-illness-away.line: One bad illness could wipe out everything I have.
one-illness-away.why: Brings back what the ID names, the fear of being one illness from ruin, instead of a general worry about cost, which also keeps it apart from personal Healthcare (getting care at all).

one-illness-away.name: Cost of illness
one-illness-away.line: Getting sick could ruin me with medical bills.
one-illness-away.why: Uses the earlier alias people recognized, and a name that says the problem rather than the paperwork.

mental-health-crisis.name: Mental health crisis
mental-health-crisis.line: I see people I care about struggling with their mental health.
mental-health-crisis.why: Keeps the line and makes the name a problem label, so the Health heading no longer mixes areas and problems.

mental-health-crisis.name: People not okay
mental-health-crisis.line: So many people around me aren't okay.
mental-health-crisis.why: The earlier alias, said the way people say it out loud; a problem label that fits the rest of the heading.

older-people-alone.name: Older people alone
older-people-alone.line: I see older people left on their own.
older-people-alone.why: Keeps the line and names the problem the ID describes; "Aging" is an area and reads like a personal worry about getting old.

older-people-alone.name: Growing old alone
older-people-alone.line: Older people around me are left to cope on their own.
older-people-alone.why: The earlier alias as the name, and a line that says plainly who is left and what that means.
